text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
During training I sensed something wrong in Duramente's 
running, and we went to the hospital. 
The diagnosis: an abnormality in the bone.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Domestic races would be fine, but I was told an overseas 
campaign, with its drastic change of environment, carried risk. 
Which meant the Arc de Triomphe...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Hold to the dream, or give it up? ...I agonized over it. 
In the end I decided to forgo the overseas campaign. 
Duramente said she would focus on racing at home.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
--It stung. If only I had the skill... 
we might not have had to give up the Arc de Triomphe. 
...Things cannot stay as they are.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
So I resolved to seek instruction from her family. 
I will absorb their knowledge and their technique, and send her 
to the Kikuka Sho in perfect condition, whatever it takes!
